preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists of lowercase Latin alphabet characters only.

postconditions.description: The output string t contains the same set of characters as the input string s, with each character appearing the same number of times.

postconditions.expression: all(t[i:j] == t[i:j][::-1] for i in range(len(t)) for j in range(i+1, len(t)+1))
postconditions.description: The output string t has the maximum possible number of palindromic substrings.
